name: ci-no-preflight-lane
title: Consumer CI runs no review preflight, so Trellis and documentation defects merge green
description: Decide and record whether this repository's CI should enforce the vendored review preflight server-side. tests.yml runs no Node and validates no Trellis record, so the preflight's record and documentation-reference checks never gate a merge. They do run locally -- sd-create-pr requires the preflight before pushing and sd-finish-work invokes its pre-archive and final-bundle modes -- but those are instructions to an agent, not mechanisms, and the full-check wrapper additionally fails open on a missing Node.
creator: sdelmas
